scope: Short supervised forward-command diagnosis requested after supported stand and forward attempt
previous_runtime_review: project-relative go1_gym_deploy/configs/evidence/himloco_go1_supported_runtime_review_20261025.json SHA256=3bf6852a50d307afefc47e45184b06d6eef511e33b07453249b4b9718ccd9882; supervised fixed-support contact trial; hardware policy results pending

observations.operator_report: Support removed; robot bore weight and stood. Operator confirmed all feet mostly stayed on the ground with body leaning/slow shifting, rather than three legs stepping and one leg stuck.
observations.interpretation: Forward command reached policy. FL/RR calf tracking differed under load; not evidence of a single failed motor. No clear periodic stepping in requested targets at the current low command.

training_reference.meaning: Nonzero training resampling has planar magnitude above 0.20 m/s. Deployment 0.15 m/s commands are still supplied to the actor and are not automatically zeroed by the exported network.
training_reference.uncertainty: A value above 0.20 does not guarantee gait initiation; actual training-run metadata and unloaded same-command tracking are not available.

parameter_change.meaning: Raise only linear forward/reverse stick range to +/-0.30 m/s, retaining zero center, deadzone and linear scaling. No forced minimum-speed jump.

diagnostic_changes: Log MCU torque estimates and raw sticks alongside requested targets and joint feedback
Print requested velocities once per second during RUNNING
operation: Use clear space and fall-catching support that does not touch legs. Sticks centered for calibration and handover. On a deliberate short forward check, verify printed vx near +0.25 to +0.30 m/s. Center sticks after 1-2 seconds; L2 if feet do not alternate or body leans/collapses. Do not increase gains or disable watchdogs to force motion.
